title: Come Down Here
logline: Every Sunday morning my mom calls us downstairs for coffee, the one hour a week our whole family is in the same room.
audience: my family (mom, dad, my sister, my brother), watching on their phones (vertical) in our family chat.
intent: at the end they feel seen and grateful: this ordinary Sunday ritual is what keeps us close, whatever the week brought.
style_block: Warm painterly illustration style, rich golden morning light, soft textures, cozy atmosphere, subject centred, 9:16 safe, no text in images.

characters.description: Housekeeper preparing coffee, seen only as gentle, adept hands.
Parents and three teenage/young-adult siblings, only from behind or as dark silhouettes.

MOM.style_instruction: calling loudly from downstairs, warm but insistent

NARRATOR.style_instruction: Warm, reflective, calm, first-person narration with gentle pacing.

music_cues.caption: gentle acoustic guitar and soft plucked lyre, light hand percussion, Ethiopian tizita-inspired nostalgic pentatonic feel, warm, reflective, homely, no strong lead melody, instrumental
music_cues.ab_caption: Warm acoustic guitar paired with soft traditional masenqo and gentle percussive rhythm, warm, reflective, homely.

shots.reason: Establishes the weekly morning call from downstairs that initiates the ritual.
shots.image_prompt: An upstairs bedroom bathed in warm golden morning light pouring through an open wooden doorway, cosy atmosphere, no visible face.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow camera zoom toward the open bedroom door frame in soft morning light.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Every Sunday morning, it starts the same way: my mom's voice, from downstairs.

shots.reason: Shows the movement of stepping away from the busy week and heading toward family.
shots.image_prompt: Feet in house slippers coming down a staircase, lit by soft side morning sunlight.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow downward pan following the slippered feet down the stairs.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Whatever the week was, we come down.

shots.reason: Introduces the careful preparation of the coffee ritual already underway.
shots.image_prompt: Adept hands washing raw green coffee beans in a clay bowl of clear water, water drops glistening in warm morning light, fresh green grass scattered around the coffee-making area.
shots.motion_prompt: The hands gently swirl the beans in the water; the camera slowly pushes in.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Downstairs, the coffee has already begun.

shots.reason: Focuses on the sensory aroma of roasting beans wafting up through the house.
shots.image_prompt: Darkening coffee beans roasting over glowing embers in a flat pan, gentle smoke rising upward toward a background staircase, fresh green grass scattered around the coffee-making area.
shots.motion_prompt: Thin smoke rises slowly from the pan; the camera holds steady with a very slow push in.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The beans crackle in the pan, and the smell climbs the stairs before we do.

shots.reason: Captures the unhurried atmosphere enhanced by fragrant frankincense smoke.
shots.image_prompt: A round-bodied black clay coffee pot with a long narrow neck and spout, on glowing coals, beside a small clay incense burner with white frankincense smoke curling upward, fresh green grass scattered around the coffee-making area.
shots.motion_prompt: White smoke curls gently upward; the camera slowly pushes in.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Etan smoke curls through the room. Nobody is in a hurry.

shots.reason: Highlights the homely snacks, popcorn and sometimes kolo, set out on the big living-room table.
shots.image_prompt: A bowl of popcorn and some roasted barley grains on the big table in the middle of the living room; wooden floor, four sofas arranged around the carpeted area.
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle pull back from the bowl of popcorn and roasted barley grains to reveal the big table and the sofas around it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: There's popcorn, sometimes kolo, and a lot of noise.

shots.reason: Shows the initial round of coffee, abol, as conversation about the week begins.
shots.image_prompt: The family seen from behind, sitting on sofas around a carpet and a big table, small handleless white porcelain coffee cups in their hands, in a living room with a wooden floor and four sofas arranged around a carpeted area with a big table in the middle; in the foreground, the coffee-making area with a round-bodied black clay coffee pot with a long narrow neck and spout and a low wooden coffee stand holding more small handleless white porcelain coffee cups, fresh green grass scattered around the coffee-making area.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow pan left across the family seen from behind on the sofas.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: With the first cup, abol, we catch up on the week: school, tests, work.

shots.reason: Illustrates lively family animated discussions during the second cup, tona.
shots.image_prompt: Silhouettes of two siblings sitting together on one of the living-room sofas, back to camera, gesturing lively in laughter against a warm backlit window, in a living room with a wooden floor and four sofas arranged around a carpeted area with a big table in the middle.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow zoom in toward laughing sibling silhouettes framed by sunlight.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: With the second, tona, it's university applications, and everyone has an opinion.

shots.reason: Focuses on the calmer third round, baraka, bringing peaceful blessing.
shots.image_prompt: The housekeeper's hand pouring coffee from the round-bodied black clay pot into a small handleless white cup, soft warm late-morning light, fresh green grass scattered around the coffee-making area.
shots.motion_prompt: A thin steady stream of coffee pours into the cup; the camera holds still.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The third cup is baraka, the blessing. The room gets quieter.

shots.reason: Signals that the real value of the ritual is togetherness rather than the drink itself.
shots.image_prompt: Small empty handleless white porcelain coffee cups on a low wooden coffee stand, wisps of white frankincense smoke fading into warm soft air, fresh green grass scattered around the coffee-making area.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow camera pull back from the empty cups on the low wooden coffee stand.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The coffee was never really the point.

shots.reason: Concludes on the warm family home exterior, grounding the recurring weekly bond.
shots.image_prompt: A two-storey white house behind a white gate with a small garden, late-morning sun.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow pull back from the brightly lit family house exterior.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: It's the one hour every week we're all in the same room. Next Sunday, she'll call again, and we'll come down.

end_card.text:
Come Down Here
for my family
